authorization: Repository owner explicitly requested the Tiny Tour building and its original 2D design sheet in Workshop.
adaptation: Original Tiny Tour design sheet and its prompt remain byte-identical.
Owner-requested geometry remodel: curved closed roof tiles, segmented ridge caps, masonry, exposed timber, framed windows and terrace joinery.
Standalone Workshop exports embed an original painted texture atlas.
Four detail levels retain the base-centred origin and source node names. Wall depth is corrected from 9 m to 7 m and the roof silhouette is rebuilt against the original sheet.
Game runtime uses a separate consuming-project named-surface/vertex-colour adapter; no game shader policy is added to Workshop core.

original_reference.origin: Historical AI-generated 2D design sheet used as the original modelling input; provider/model not recorded here.
original_reference.note: Original means the prior design input, not an export of this mesh. Copied byte-for-byte from the recorded Tiny Tour commit.

remodel.material_derivation: Four quadrants resized to 512-square NumPy arrays; source-generated paint crops/tints provide per-surface atlas cells. Artwork is new material art, not the historical 2D building reference.

shape_correction.basis: Owner feedback that wall depth and timber roof build-out did not match the sheet.
shape_correction.integration_authorization: Owner requested integration into Workshop and Tiny Tour; later feedback requires corrected geometry before integration.
shape_correction.artistic_approval: not separately asserted for the corrected export

remodel.entrance_detail: Two independently framed door leaves with lower timber panels, upper glazing lattice, central join and paired handles; projecting corner stones and terrace-post stone plinths.
remodel.roof_joinery_detail: Front and end gables use diagonal struts rising outward from the low centre beside the king post (\|/); raised ceramic verge, hip and ridge caps and thicker tile noses.
remodel.roof_apron_fix: Tile occlusion is bounded by the actual front-gable end; exposed main-roof tiles continue below the gable sill, including a short closure course.
remodel.ground_and_gable_correction: Broad flat sloping gable timbers placed visibly below and in front of the ceramic verge; corner and terrace-post stones reach ground, with plinth faces projecting beyond the wooden terrace.
